properties.description: Network host on which the Fabric DNS server listens.

properties.description: Network port on which the Fabric DNS server listens.

properties.description: Maximum raw DNS responses retained by the Fabric DNS server cache.

properties.description: Raw DNS response cache time to live.

properties.description: Window during which expired DNS cache entries may be served after refresh failure.
